title: Bourbon Minecraft
description: This modpack improves visuals and performance while revamping the Nether and End for more rewarding exploration.
body: This modpack is designed to enhance the game's overall visual appeal, offering a more polished and immersive aesthetic without altering the core mechanics that players know and love. Performance has been optimized to ensure smoother gameplay, even with the improved graphics and effects. While the game world retains its familiar feel, the Nether and End dimensions have been carefully reworked to make exploration more captivating and rewarding, with new environmental features and challenges that add depth and excitement to these previously underexplored areas. This balance of visual enhancement and optimization ensures a richer, yet seamless gaming experience.
